newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin, on holiday, prepares for Jiang visit.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin, on holiday, prepares for Jiang visit.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin, on holiday by the Black Sea, was making final preparations on Monday for a visit to Russia by Chinese President Jiang Zemin, the Kremlin said.
A spokesman for Yeltsin's press office said the Kremlin leader was expected to fly to Moscow on Tuesday from the resort of Sochi, where he has been resting since Friday.
He did not say when Yeltsin, 66, would return to Sochi to resume his holiday, but Itar-Tass news agency said he would be back there by next weekend.
Yeltsin, who had heart surgery last November, often spends his holidays in Sochi and doctors say the vacation was not forced by ill health.

Jiang arrives in Moscow on a five-day visit on Tuesday and will meet Yeltsin on Wednesday. He is due to sign a border troop reduction pact with Yeltsin and leaders of three Central Asian states during his visit.
Beijing and Moscow were firm allies in the 1950s but ties worsened in the next decades in a battle for leadership of the communist world in which border skirmishes flared.
Relations have been improving since Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev visited Beijing in 1989.
